entries.name: AND gate
entries.summary: A logic element whose output is true when all stated positive-logic inputs are true.

entries.name: OR gate
entries.summary: A positive-logic element whose output is true when at least one input is true.

entries.name: NAND gate
entries.summary: A logic gate that inverts the result of an AND operation.

entries.name: NOR gate
entries.summary: A logic gate that inverts an inclusive-OR result.

entries.name: Exclusive-OR gate
entries.summary: For two positive-logic inputs, produces a true output when the input states differ.

entries.name: Exclusive-NOR gate
entries.summary: For two positive-logic inputs, produces a true output when the input states are equal.

entries.name: Logic inverter
entries.summary: Produces the opposite logical state of its defined digital input.

entries.name: Non-inverting logic buffer
entries.summary: Transfers a digital state through a non-inverting logic output stage.

entries.name: Three-state logic buffer
entries.summary: A digital output stage that can drive logical states or enter its documented high-impedance state.

entries.name: Schmitt-trigger inverter
entries.summary: A digital inverter with hysteresis between its input switching thresholds.

entries.name: Schmitt-trigger buffer
entries.summary: A non-inverting digital element with separate rising and falling input thresholds.

entries.name: Positive-edge D flip-flop
entries.summary: Captures its data input at the documented positive clock edge and retains that digital state.

entries.name: Negative-edge JK flip-flop
entries.summary: Updates or toggles its stored state from J and K inputs at the selected negative clock edge.

entries.name: Set-reset latch
entries.summary: Retains a digital state that is changed by the defined set or reset input conditions.

entries.name: Transparent D latch
entries.summary: Follows the input data while its latch-enable condition is active and retains it when that condition ends.

entries.name: Serial-in parallel-out register
entries.summary: Shifts serial input data through storage stages to parallel outputs at the documented clock events.

entries.name: Parallel-in serial-out register
entries.summary: Loads a parallel word and presents its bits through a serial shift output.

entries.name: Shift register with output latch
entries.summary: Combines a serial shift path with a separate output-storage stage.

entries.name: Ripple binary counter
entries.summary: Counts clock events through cascaded storage stages whose output changes do not occur simultaneously.

entries.name: Synchronous binary counter
entries.summary: Updates its binary count from a common clock with the documented count-enable, load and clear controls.

entries.name: Decoded decade counter
entries.summary: Advances a decoded output sequence through the documented ten-state counter arrangement.

entries.name: Retriggerable monostable
entries.summary: Produces a timed output pulse that can be extended by a qualifying retrigger condition.

entries.name: Binary decoder / demultiplexer
entries.summary: Uses binary selection and enable conditions to activate the documented selected output.

entries.name: Priority encoder
entries.summary: Encodes the highest-priority qualifying input into the specified binary output word.

entries.name: Digital multiplexer
entries.summary: Selects one of several digital inputs for the documented output according to its selection controls.

entries.name: Digital magnitude comparator
entries.summary: Compares two digital words to provide the specified equality and magnitude indications.

entries.name: Binary full adder
entries.summary: Adds binary input words with the documented carry-in and produces sum and carry outputs.

entries.name: Logic bus transceiver
entries.summary: Drives data between two digital buses according to the selected direction and enable conditions.

entries.name: Logic voltage-level translator
entries.summary: Transfers digital information between the documented logic-voltage domains.

entries.name: Open-collector buffer
entries.summary: Provides a logic output through a transistor pull-down stage requiring the documented external load or pull-up.

entries.name: Parity generator / checker
entries.summary: Computes a parity indication from the defined digital input word.

entries.name: Phase-locked loop
entries.summary: Controls an oscillator through a phase-comparison feedback arrangement to follow the documented reference.

entries.name: Voltage-controlled oscillator
entries.summary: Generates an oscillating output whose frequency responds to the documented control voltage.

entries.name: Clock generator
entries.summary: Provides the documented clock signal or signals used by digital circuitry.

entries.name: Watchdog timer
entries.summary: Supervises a qualifying activity signal and operates its output when the documented watchdog timing condition is violated.

entries.name: Operational amplifier
entries.summary: An analogue amplifier represented by inverting and non-inverting inputs, an output and its supply connections.

entries.name: Voltage comparator
entries.summary: Compares two analogue input voltages and produces the documented output-state indication.

entries.name: Instrumentation amplifier
entries.summary: Amplifies a differential input signal using an instrumentation-amplifier input and gain arrangement.

entries.name: Difference amplifier
entries.summary: Produces an analogue output related to the difference between two input signals with the documented gain/reference arrangement.

entries.name: Fully differential amplifier
entries.summary: Processes an analogue input to provide two complementary output signals around a defined common-mode level.

entries.name: Current-sense amplifier
entries.summary: Amplifies a voltage associated with a current-sensing shunt using the selected measurement-input arrangement.

entries.name: Isolation amplifier
entries.summary: Transfers an analogue measurement across the documented electrical isolation boundary.

entries.name: Operational transconductance amplifier
entries.summary: Produces an output current controlled by its differential input voltage and documented bias arrangement.

entries.name: Analogue multiplier
entries.summary: Produces an analogue output related to the product of two input quantities and the selected scaling/summing arrangement.

entries.name: Analogue bilateral switch
entries.summary: Connects or disconnects an analogue signal path under its documented digital control.

entries.name: Analogue multiplexer
entries.summary: Selects a continuous-signal channel through the documented controlled switching arrangement.

entries.name: Sample-and-hold amplifier
entries.summary: Acquires an analogue signal during the documented sampling interval and retains a representation during hold.

entries.name: Analogue-to-digital converter
entries.summary: Converts a sampled analogue quantity into the selected digital representation.

entries.name: Digital-to-analogue converter
entries.summary: Converts a digital code into the documented analogue output quantity.

entries.name: Series voltage reference
entries.summary: Provides a reference voltage through a series-connected supply and output arrangement.

entries.name: Shunt voltage reference
entries.summary: Establishes a reference voltage using a shunt-current path and the documented bias or feedback circuit.

entries.name: Precision rectifier
entries.summary: Uses an active amplifier/diode arrangement to rectify a signal according to the documented circuit.

entries.name: RMS-to-DC converter
entries.summary: Produces a DC output related to the RMS value of its input signal under the selected implementation.

entries.name: Voltage / frequency converter
entries.summary: Converts between an analogue voltage and a pulse-frequency representation in the documented selected configuration.

entries.name: Inverting amplifier circuit
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier feedback connection that produces the documented inverted signal relationship.

entries.name: Non-inverting amplifier circuit
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier feedback arrangement to amplify a signal without the intended polarity inversion.

entries.name: Op-amp integrator
entries.summary: Uses a documented amplifier/capacitor feedback arrangement to obtain an integrating signal response.

entries.name: Op-amp differentiator
entries.summary: Uses an amplifier input/feedback arrangement to obtain a differentiating response over its intended operating band.

entries.name: Active low-pass filter
entries.summary: Passes the intended lower-frequency signal content while attenuating higher-frequency content through an active filter circuit.

entries.name: Active high-pass filter
entries.summary: Attenuates lower-frequency content while passing the intended higher-frequency signal band.

entries.name: Active band-pass filter
entries.summary: Passes an intended frequency band while attenuating content below and above that band.

entries.name: Active notch filter
entries.summary: Attenuates a defined frequency region while retaining the intended content outside it.

entries.name: Transimpedance amplifier
entries.summary: Converts an input current into an output voltage through the documented feedback arrangement.

entries.name: Supply voltage supervisor
entries.summary: A voltage supervisor checks a supply against specified conditions and produces a status or reset signal.

entries.name: Power-good indication
entries.summary: A power-good signal reports whether the source's specified acceptable-supply conditions are satisfied.

entries.name: Window voltage supervisor
entries.summary: A window supervisor checks whether a monitored voltage stays between its specified lower and upper limits.

entries.name: Power-rail sequencer
entries.summary: A power sequencer controls the order in which selected supply rails are enabled or disabled.

entries.name: Power-rail enable interface
entries.summary: An enable interface requests a selected power supply or switched rail to operate.
